data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year release of 15.9 (reported in the strategic report) in 2019, driven by a combination of favourable reserve developments overall but with some adverse loss creep on prior catastrophe events. Natural catastrophe activity in 2019 (notably Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai) affected the underwriting year but remained within expected ranges; prior-year catastrophe loss creep was noted on Typhoon Jebi and Hurricane Maria. The reserve movement figures presented in the managing agent's report are net of reinsurance and no gross prior-year movement figure was isolated in the technical reserves notes.

data.data_quality_notes: The primary gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities) note isolating PYD was not found. The reported prior-year movements by division (total 15.9) in the strategic report are explicitly stated but are presented as releases/strengthenings net of reinsurance (the report itself states 'Releases as a percentage of net earned premium'). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is populated using the net figure (-15.9) and flagged as a fallback (net of reinsurance). No gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement line was available in the technical reserves reconciliation; total 'movement in the technical provision' is a combined current-year plus prior-year movement and was not used. Currency and amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD) as presented in the accounts.
